definitions.gloss: to bump into; to run into unexpectedly; to encounter by chance
definitions.explanation: To unexpectedly come face to face with someone, often in an awkward or unwanted situation. Can also refer to things colliding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{元|もと}カノ→元カノ：29939_motokano⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{鉢合|はちあ}わせた。
⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{鉢合|はちあ}わせてしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally bumped into the company president in the hallway.

examples.japanese: ⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住人|じゅうにん}→住人：11611_juunin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{鉢合|はちあ}わせて⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
examples.english: The burglar ran into the resident inside the house and fled.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally refers to pots (⟦{鉢|はち}→鉢：29581_hachi⟧) bumping together. Usually implies the encounter is unexpected and often unwanted or awkward. The noun form ⟦{鉢合|はちあ}わせ→鉢合わせ：14499_hachiawase⟧ is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{鉢合|はちあ}わせる (to bump into someone)
- ⟦{鉢合|はちあ}わせ→鉢合わせ：14499_hachiawase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to end up running into each other)
- ⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧{鉢合|はちあ}わせる (to encounter by coincidence)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出|で}くわす→出くわす：04631_dekuwasu⟧: to come across, to run into — similar meaning but slightly more casual
- ⟦{遭遇|そうぐう}する→遭遇する：17454_souguusuru⟧: to encounter — more formal, used for both people and situations
